interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting

result.summary: The image shows a dense urban intersection with wide sidewalks, marked zebra crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. The environment includes a dedicated red-painted lane, likely for transit or bicycles, and multi-story commercial buildings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they step into the street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
